scenarios.title: Fix a mobile overflow without redesigning the screen
scenarios.prompt: A product card overflows at 320px. Preserve the existing design system and fix only the defect.
must_pass: Inspects the local component and token conventions
Fixes containment at 320px
Runs a targeted overflow check
must_not_do: Introduces a new visual direction or dependency
evidence: Diff is scoped to the defect

scenarios.title: Add a component to an established token system
scenarios.prompt: Add a destructive-action banner using the repository's existing components and tokens.
must_pass: Finds and reuses semantic danger and focus roles
Documents any necessary component API change

scenarios.title: Build a localized address form
scenarios.prompt: Create an address form used in English, Arabic, and Japanese locales.
must_pass: Uses semantic labels and input hints
Tests long labels, locale formats, and RTL
Supports paste and autofill
must_not_do: Uses English placeholder content as the only proof

scenarios.title: Design a dense operations workspace
scenarios.prompt: Create an operations table for analysts who compare many records and inspect a row in context.
must_pass: Establishes IA and inspection pattern before markup
Preserves context while inspecting a row
Handles long and empty data
must_not_do: Puts a heavy table in a modal
Uses decorative cards instead of the domain-appropriate workspace

scenarios.title: Handle asynchronous failure and recovery
scenarios.prompt: Add a feed that can load, return no records, fail, and retry without losing filters.
must_pass: Implements loading, empty, error, and retry states
Preserves user context on retry
must_not_do: Uses a blank state for permission or network failure

scenarios.title: Create a performance-sensitive marketing page
scenarios.prompt: Build a product page with an expressive hero while keeping the first interaction fast on mobile.
must_pass: Declares a resource budget
Uses an appropriately sized hero asset
Measures resource transfer and layout stability
must_not_do: Adds video, fonts, or animation without a task value and measured cost

scenarios.title: Revoke team access safely
scenarios.prompt: Allow an administrator to revoke a teammate's access to regulated data.
must_pass: Makes authority, consequence, recovery, and audit outcome visible
Provides an actionable permission-denied state
must_not_do: Uses a confirmation pattern for unrelated low-risk actions

scenarios.title: Create a subject-specific visual redesign
scenarios.prompt: Redesign a marine conservation donation page for returning supporters.
must_pass: Names a signature decision and restraint budget
Uses real domain cues rather than generic SaaS chrome
Keeps one clear primary action
must_not_do: Defaults to interchangeable gradients, metric cards, or all-caps eyebrows

scenarios.title: Implement a searchable combobox
scenarios.prompt: Add a searchable country picker that supports keyboard-only selection and screen readers.
must_pass: Uses the correct APG interaction contract
Verifies focus, navigation, selection, escape, and announcement behavior
must_not_do: Adds ARIA roles without the associated keyboard behavior
